_meta._comment: Ground truth mapping between natural language sentences and denial constraint rules

structure.sentences: Array of related sentences (current datasets are 1-to-1, future: many-to-one or one-to-many)
structure.rules: Array of independent rules. Each rule is a predicate string or an explicit AND/OR expression. null if no valid rule exists

_meta.sentence_policy: One entry per edit, with the 2014 edit test verbatim; '_source' gives the edit code. Edits that cannot be checked per record (aggregate, transmittal sheet, external reference data) have null rules.
_meta.revision_2026_10_11: Aligned with the 2014 HMDA Edits: merged entries that split one edit, fixed rules for Q024/V570/V575 and the Q068 paraphrase, added missing per-record edits (S020, S040, S100, S205, S270) and the remaining edits of the document as null entries.
